description: Create the Tajweed lessons UI and content: lesson list screen, lesson detail screen with text/audio examples, and pre-populated lesson data for all major Tajweed rules (Izhor, Idg'om, Ikhfo, Iqlab, Ghunna, Qalqala, Madd, etc.)
steps: Create the app theme in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/theme/: Color.kt (Islamic-inspired green/gold palette), Type.kt (typography with Arabic-supporting fonts), Theme.kt (Material3 dynamic theme with light/dark), Shape.kt

Create common UI components in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/components/: TajweedTopBar.kt, BottomNavBar.kt (Home, Lessons, Practice, Progress), LessonCard.kt, ArabicText.kt (styled Arabic text display with tajweed color coding), AudioPlayerBar.kt, ProgressIndicator.kt, RuleChip.kt
Create Home screen in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/screens/home/: HomeScreen.kt (welcome, daily progress summary, quick access to lessons/practice), HomeViewModel.kt

Create Lessons screens in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/screens/lessons/: LessonsListScreen.kt (grid/list of tajweed rule categories), LessonDetailScreen.kt (rule explanation, Arabic examples with color-coded tajweed, audio playback button, practice button), LessonsViewModel.kt

Create pre-populated Tajweed lesson data in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/data/local/TajweedData.kt - define all rules: Izhor (clear pronunciation of Nun Sakin/Tanwin before throat letters), Idg'om Bila Ghunna (merging without nasalization), Idg'om Ma'al Ghunna (merging with nasalization), Ikhfo (hiding/concealing the sound), Iqlab (converting Nun to Meem before Ba), Ghunna (nasalization), Qalqala (echoing/bouncing of certain letters), Madd Tabii (natural prolongation), Madd Munfasil (separated prolongation), Madd Muttasil (connected prolongation). Each rule includes: name in Arabic and Uzbek, description, Arabic examples with ayah references, explanation of when the rule applies

Create Quran verses/pages data in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/data/local/QuranData.kt - include selected Quran ayahs (surahs) organized for practice. Include: Surah Al-Fatiha (full), selected ayahs from Surah Al-Baqarah, Surah Ya-Sin, Surah Al-Mulk, Surah Ar-Rahman, and short surahs (An-Nas, Al-Falaq, Al-Ikhlas, Al-Kawthar, etc.). Each entry has: surahNumber, ayahNumber, arabicText, transliterationUz (Uzbek transliteration), translationUz (Uzbek translation), and tajweedRules (list of rule IDs that apply to this ayah). This data is used for practice reading sessions.

Create a Quran reader screen in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/screens/quran/: QuranScreen.kt (browse surahs), QuranReaderScreen.kt (display ayahs with tajweed color coding, tap on ayah to practice reading it), QuranViewModel.kt
Create a database pre-population callback in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/data/local/DatabaseCallback.kt that inserts all TajweedData and QuranData on first app launch
acceptance_criteria: Theme files define a cohesive Islamic-inspired color scheme with Material3
All common UI components are reusable Composable functions
Home screen shows welcome message, progress summary, and navigation
Lessons list displays all tajweed rule categories in a scrollable grid
Lesson detail shows rule name (Arabic + Uzbek), description, Arabic examples, and has audio/practice buttons
At least 10 tajweed rules are defined with complete data (name, description, examples)
Database callback pre-populates rules on first launch
Bottom navigation provides access to all main sections
verification: Verify TajweedData.kt contains at least 10 rules with Arabic examples
Verify all screen Composables accept proper parameters and use Material3 components
Verify ViewModels use Hilt injection and expose StateFlow
Verify theme files define both light and dark color schemes
findings: All 25 files created/modified successfully. Cannot run Gradle build due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. Files verified for correct package declarations, import consistency, and proper annotation usage. QuranData includes page numbers (bet raqamlari) for all surahs as requested by user. DatabaseCallback uses @ApplicationScope qualified CoroutineScope from AppModule. LessonDetailViewModel uses SavedStateHandle for ruleId. Added LessonDetailViewModel.kt (not in original plan but needed for LessonDetailScreen). QuranScreen shows page numbers in surah list items.
